status: REVISION (noise-model covariance validation against the measured Neuromag noise, MNE sample subject)

requests.codex_major_1: Extend the checks beyond median channel RMS to held-out channelwise variances, spatial correlations, covariance eigenstructure and spectral behavior where the supplied measurement framework permits. Distinguish quantities fitted to data from independent predictions.
requests.fable_major_1: That model is calibrated on one scalar (median Neuromag gradiometer variance), under-predicts the measured magnetometer brain noise by 27 % (0.73x), spans 0.13-0.78 of the measured per-channel variance on the magnetometers

fitted_vs_predicted.quantity: cortical background scale (one scalar; one per sub-band in the band analysis)
fitted_vs_predicted.data: median over the good gradiometers of the measured brain variance (task baseline - empty room) in the band
empty-room recording; acts only inside the 8-dimensional external subspace of the model's empty-room and total covariance

fitted_vs_predicted.quantity: sensor white noise (3.5 fT/sqrt(Hz), 3.6 fT/(cm sqrt(Hz)))
fitted_vs_predicted.data: compared with the empty-room variances outside the room-field subspace

fitted_vs_predicted.quantity: gradiometer brain variances at held-out sites (scale fitted on the other half)

fitted_vs_predicted.role: independent prediction (only the overall scale is fitted)

fitted_vs_predicted.quantity: magnetometer variance and channel patterns per sub-band
fitted_vs_predicted.role: independent prediction (scale refitted per band on the gradiometers)

fitted_vs_predicted.quantity: Neuromag detectability with the measured covariance

declared_choices.sub_band_note: conventional delta, theta, alpha, low beta, high beta and low gamma edges inside the 1-40 Hz analysis band
declared_choices.structure_units: each channel divided by its brochure sensor-noise SD (unit-free; only the combined eigenstructure depends on it)
declared_choices.surrogate_method: multivariate phase randomisation of the filtered continuous records (same random phase for every channel at each frequency)

independent_mag_calibrated.label: independent sources, calibrated on the magnetometers

correlated_5mm.label: correlated sources (5 mm), calibrated on the gradiometers

correlated_10mm.label: correlated sources (10 mm), calibrated on the gradiometers

held_out.spatial_split_rule: device frame: left/right at x = 0; posterior/anterior and inferior/superior at the median site coordinate

cardiac_check.method: mne.preprocessing.find_ecg_events (defaults; synthetic ECG from the magnetometers); cardiac-locked average of the band-passed task recording over one median R-R cycle, subtracted from every baseline sample at its offset from the nearest R peak; 'heart' variance = baseline variance before - after the subtraction

time_locked_check.note: baseline windows after removing their time-locked average per event type (any residual evoked response from the preceding stimulus); the model is not refitted

detectability.note: measured = sample covariance of the task baselines; corrected = divided per target by the finite-sample bias of detectability with a covariance estimated from these samples (stationary surrogates with the measured cross-spectra); null = the model covariance 'as it would be measured' (surrogates recoloured to the model), so measured/model inside the null range is what an exact model would give; hybrid = measured empty room + model brain. Parcel CIs cover the choice of targets only, not the finite recording (see surrogate_medians).

assumptions.model_306: G2 as published: model covariance for both systems, Neuromag with all 306 channels
assumptions.model_305: model covariance for both systems, Neuromag without the bad channel (the reference for the rows below)
assumptions.S1_same_relative_change: the OPM's real covariance changes its detectability by the same factor, target by target, as the measured covariance changes Neuromag's (the model's error is common to both systems): the ratio is that of the model (identical to model_305 by construction)
assumptions.S2_same_variance_excess_both_modelled: both systems' cortical background scaled by the measured magnetometer variance excess k (model structure kept; = G2's magnetometer-calibrated sensitivity)
assumptions.S3_neuromag_measured_opm_variance_excess: Neuromag with its measured covariance (finite-sample corrected); the OPM with its cortical background scaled by k: the OPM bears the full magnetometer variance excess as cortical-like noise and none of the measured structure (a pessimistic bound for the OPM)
assumptions.S4_neuromag_measured_opm_as_modelled: Neuromag with its measured covariance (finite-sample corrected); the OPM exactly as modelled (the model's error is Neuromag-specific)
assumptions.S5_neuromag_measured_empty_room: Neuromag with the measured empty room + model brain (finite-sample corrected); the OPM as modelled (isolates the sensor and room part of Neuromag's noise)
assumptions.variants: the OPM and Neuromag background both from the named variant (model rows), or Neuromag measured and the OPM from the variant (measured rows)

opm_implication.condition: OPM: sensor + brain + room (G2 'intrinsic+brain+env'), like for like with the measured Neuromag covariance; model_306/intrinsic+brain is the G2 headline condition; 'projected' rows remove the 8-term external subspace (Neuromag measured rows there are not finite-sample corrected)

sub_bands.note: the model has no brain spectrum: its cortical background has one spatial covariance at every frequency, rescaled per band on the gradiometers; it therefore predicts a band-independent magnetometer/gradiometer brain-variance ratio and channel pattern. 'closure_median' = per channel, sum of the sub-band variances / full-band variance (median over channels; filter-bank check: the sub-bands' skirts overlap).

channels.note: good channels, native units (T^2 for magnetometers, (T/m)^2 for gradiometers), variances in the analysis band

plain_summary: Fitted: one scale of the cortical background (the median good-gradiometer brain-noise variance) and the room field's 8 x 8 coefficient covariance (empty room). Everything below except the gradiometer median is an independent prediction.
Magnetometer brain-noise amplitude (median): model/measured 0.73; an exact model, measured the same way, would give 0.98-1.03.

Gradiometers: the scale fitted on half the sites predicts the other half's median amplitude to 1.00 [0.93, 1.09] over random halves, but 1.34 (fitted below, predicting above) and 0.75 (fitted above, predicting below).

Per-channel pattern (Pearson r of log variances, model vs measured): magnetometers 0.14, gradiometers 0.43, against a split-half reliability of the measurement of 0.93 and 0.97; per-channel model/measured variance 5th-95th percentile 0.13-0.78 (magnetometers) and 0.19-1.90 (gradiometers), where an exact model would give about 0.95-1.06.

The magnetometers' excess over the model is concentrated: its leading 3 components hold 91% of it, and 91% of the leading component lies in the 8-dimensional far-field (external) subspace (a random direction: 8%).

The heart (cardiac-locked average, 282 beats) adds 127 fT RMS (median magnetometer) to the baseline windows: 25% of the measured magnetometer brain variance and 51% of the model's shortfall; without it the magnetometer prediction is 0.89 of the measured amplitude and the channel-pattern correlation rises to 0.76 (magnetometers) and 0.66 (gradiometers).
Magnetometer prediction per band (model/measured amplitude, model rescaled per band on the gradiometers): 1-4 Hz 0.97, 4-8 Hz 0.93, 8-13 Hz 0.85, 13-20 Hz 0.72, 20-30 Hz 0.57, 30-40 Hz 0.33.

Neuromag combined: detectability with the measured covariance / model 1.142 [1.084, 1.202] after the finite-sample correction (uncorrected 1.180; an exact model, measured the same way, would give 0.997-1.006); measured empty room + model brain 1.009; heart removed 1.147.

Neuromag mag: detectability with the measured covariance / model 1.059 [1.003, 1.119] after the finite-sample correction (uncorrected 1.072; an exact model, measured the same way, would give 0.995-1.005); measured empty room + model brain 0.996; heart removed 1.066.

Neuromag grad: detectability with the measured covariance / model 1.122 [1.066, 1.184] after the finite-sample correction (uncorrected 1.147; an exact model, measured the same way, would give 0.996-1.005); measured empty room + model brain 1.018; heart removed 1.133.
By lobe (all channels, measured/model): cingulate 1.40, frontal 1.25, insula 1.06, occipital 1.07, other 1.03, parietal 1.19, temporal 0.89.

opm_dense / Neuromag (all channels, sensor + brain + room): both modelled 1.140 [1.117, 1.171]; S1 same relative change in both 1.141 [1.117, 1.168]; S2 both backgrounds x k 1.142 [1.118, 1.167]; S5 Neuromag measured empty room 1.130 [1.103, 1.156]; S4 Neuromag measured, OPM as modelled 1.034 [0.986, 1.083]; S3 Neuromag measured, OPM background x k 0.799 [0.760, 0.842].
